decision_needed: Accept a limited academic demonstration with explicit subgroup limitations, or require validated safeguards for low/zero rotation.
Agree business or academic group-error tolerances before any final acceptance.
Approve a separate training protocol if feature/loss/routing changes are requested.
actions_without_training: Review all 17 worsened products using supplied row errors.
Review information available at cutoff for known orders, cancellations and availability.
Confirm synthetic academic scope and no claim of causal price/exchange effects.
future_experiments_require_authorization: TRAIN-only frequency, recency and recent-level features with time-safe computation.
Intermittent-demand baseline or two-stage occurrence/quantity model.
Predeclared alternative loss or forest capacity search inside temporal TRAIN folds.
Fixed history-based routing rule tested temporally, never an oracle based on realized target.
Contract for known commitments distinct from uncommitted sales, avoiding double-counting.
not_done: No new model selection, training, routing, deployment or TEST evaluation.
No dataset change, reweighting, deletion of difficult rows or use of future fulfilled quantities as features.
test_policy: Keep existing TEST reserved. Never use it to select thresholds, repair subgroups or choose the next experiment.
